name: Random Charts
body:
Now you can roll the dice to generate random results off of various Gamemaster tables courtesy of MonsterAdvancer.com;

Roll on all the charts simultaneously

OR

Roll on one of the following charts:

Backgrounds
Plots
Plot Twists
Rewards
Secrets
Characteristics
Physical Characteristics/Quirks
Goals
Quest Item/Macguffins (What is a macguffin?)

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
